Name: Multi-User Chests
Author: MindMeltMax
TagLine: Allows multiple people to access a chest at the same time
Description:
**Description :**
This mod will allow 2+ people to access a chest at once.
 It's a bit buggy when multiple people try to change the color, but that's not what it's made for.

**Installation :**
1. Install [Smapi](http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
2. Unzip file and place in mod folder
3. You can now steal your friends stuff while he's still in his chest... yay

**Also :**
For the mod to work properly, each party must have it installed

**Update 1.0.2 :**
Changed something minor which should improve mod compatibility
